name: Primal Monkes
summary: In Primal Monkes, you're not just playing tag—you're fighting to survive in a relentless game of life and death. The pitch-black world around you is teeming with terrifying, primal monsters, lurking just out of sight, always on the hunt. Every shadow feels alive, every noise sends chills down your spine, and every step could bring you closer to danger.
